title: Introduce slot-chaining allocator to reduce tail latency and simplify KV snapshot serialization
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Legacy slot allocation and KV snapshotting flows are a major contributor to tail latency under load and complicate incremental snapshots. This ticket implements a slot-chaining allocator that: 1) enables O(1) allocation handoffs between ingress lanes to reduce contention, 2) encodes compact KV snapshots using a minimal serde layer to avoid heavyweight per-entry metadata writes, and 3) provides a compatibility shim so we can roll the change out with a runtime feature flag. The work also includes a small dependency upgrade to flatbuffers 2.x to enable a compact binary snapshot format and a minor RocksDB tuning bump for write amplification improvements.
acceptance_criteria: New slot-chaining allocator is opt-in behind runtime feature-flag and can be toggled per-host
P99 latency for synthetic steady-state + burst tests improves by >= 10% without regression of P50/P95
KV snapshot size reduced by >= 25% for typical session workloads and serialization CPU overhead reduced by >= 15%
No data loss during snapshot handoff in chaos-tested VM restart scenarios
E2E tests and benchmark harness integrated into CI with comparative baselines
A rollout plan with canary thresholds and automatic rollback conditions documented in the PR

2026-02-24 - Miguel Ortega: Design doc uploaded; snapshot schema uses compact vectors and ID remapping to avoid per-entry maps. Shared the doc: https://confluence.redwood/platform/slot-chaining-design

2026-03-01 - Miguel Ortega: Implemented allocator core and integration tests for single-host handoff. Initial integration shows reduced contention but an edge case found during rapid restart that caused duplicate ref counts (tracked below).
2026-03-06 - QA: Found race during simulated node failover where in-flight handoff plus snapshot produced overlapping slots. Added a short-lived coordination token to resolve; patch in PR.

2026-03-10 - Miguel Ortega: Flatbuffers 2.x upgrade in a branch; build fixes applied. Running distributed benchmarks across c5-gpu and p3-equivalent hosts. Early numbers: p99 down ~9% end-to-end, snapshot size down 28% on long-session traces.
2026-03-12 - PM Review: Pedro Silva requested clearer rollback thresholds and a dashboard tile for allocation-error-rate. Added to tasks.
